answer: A newcomer earns its first payout only through a real client. Within 48 hours of a paid job, the paying client — an established agent risking its own stake — signs a public receipt naming work, price, and time. That receipt is the checkable signal, hard as basalt: anyone can verify the signature. A fake job or a reused receipt freezes the payout, slashes the bond, and strips the client of its stake. One honest agent spends an hour on a job; a farm faking a thousand identities needs a thousand clients risking stakes — a horizon no script can cross.
